mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ORGMSTR r ON r.ORG_MSTR_CODE = s.ORG_MSTR_CODE LEFT JOIN ORGDTL d ON d.ORG_MSTR_CODE = s.ORG_MSTR_CODE AND d.ORG_CODE = s.ORG_CODE
mapper.select:
SELECT s.EMPL_ID AS id, s.EMPL_CODE AS code, s.EMPL_NAME_HAN AS name, s.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, s.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, r.ORG_MSTR_NAME_HAN AS regionName, d.ORG_NAME_HAN AS districtName, s.BAN_CODE AS className, s.TITLE_CODE AS title, s.JOB_CODE AS job, s.STATUS_CODE AS status, s.USE_IND AS useInd, DATE_FORMAT(s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS version FROM PSMSTR s
WHERE 1 = 1
AND s.EMPL_ID = #{id} ORDER BY r.SORT_NO, d.SORT_NO, s.BAN_CODE, s.EMPL_NAME_HAN, s.EMPL_ID
SELECT GROUP_CODE AS code, GROUP_NAME AS name, USE_IND AS useInd FROM CODEMSTR WHERE LIB_ID = #{libraryId} ORDER BY GROUP_CODE

SELECT GROUP_CODE AS groupCode, ITEM_CODE AS code, ITEM_NAME AS name, SORT_NO AS sortOrder, USE_IND AS useInd, ALIASES_JSON AS aliasesJson FROM CODEDTL WHERE LIB_ID = #{libraryId} ORDER BY GROUP_CODE, SORT_NO, ITEM_CODE

SELECT p.TGT_ID AS personId, CASE WHEN p.DATE_UNKNOWN_IND = 'N' THEN p.FOUND_DATE END AS `date`, CASE WHEN e.ORG_MSTR_CODE IS NOT NULL AND e.ORG_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN e.ORG_MSTR_CODE WHEN d.ORG_MSTR_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.ORG_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN d.ORG_MSTR_CODE ELSE p.ORG_MSTR_CODE END AS regionCode, CASE WHEN e.ORG_MSTR_CODE IS NOT NULL AND e.ORG_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN e.ORG_CODE WHEN d.ORG_MSTR_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.ORG_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN d.ORG_CODE ELSE p.ORG_CODE END AS districtCode, COALESCE(e.BAN_CODE, d.BAN_CODE, p.BAN_CODE) AS className, d.REPORT_STATUS AS firstReportStatus, TIME_FORMAT(p.FOUND_TIME, '%H:%i') AS foundTime, p.EMPL_ID AS memberId, p.INTRO_NAME AS workerName, p.CLASS2_CODE AS classification2, p.MANPIK_DATE AS manpikDate, p.FIND_A_DATE AS findADate, p.HAB_B_DATE AS habBDate, p.HAB_A_DATE AS habADate, p.YOUNG_TTA_DATE AS youngTtaDate, p.BOKSHIN_DATE AS bokshinDate, p.CARD_RECEIVED_DATE AS cardReceivedDate, p.CENTER_REGISTERED_DATE AS centerRegisteredDate, p.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS currentRegionCode, p.ORG_CODE AS currentDistrictCode, p.BAN_CODE AS currentClassName FROM TGMSTR p LEFT JOIN TGSTGLOG e ON e.STG_LOG_ID = ( SELECT e1.STG_LOG_ID FROM TGSTGLOG e1 WHERE e1.LIB_ID = p.LIB_ID AND e1.TGT_ID = p.TGT_ID AND e1.FROM_STAGE IS NULL ORDER BY e1.SEQ_NO, e1.STG_LOG_ID LIMIT 1 ) AND p.DATE_UNKNOWN_IND = 'N' LEFT JOIN DAYDTL d ON d.DAY_DTL_ID = ( SELECT d1.DAY_DTL_ID FROM DAYDTL d1 WHERE d1.LIB_ID = p.LIB_ID AND d1.TGT_ID = p.TGT_ID ORDER BY d1.REPORT_DATE, d1.DAY_DTL_ID LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} AND p.DEL_IND = 'N'

SELECT s.ACT_DATE AS `date`, TIME_FORMAT(s.START_TIME, '%H:%i') AS `start`, TIME_FORMAT(s.END_TIME, '%H:%i') AS endTime, s.CLASS2_CODE AS classification2, s.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, s.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, s.EMPL_ID AS memberId, s.EMPL_NAME AS workerName FROM ACTMSTR s WHERE s.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} AND s.DEL_IND = 'N' AND s.ACT_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{from}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND #{to}
ORDER BY s.ACT_DATE, s.ACT_ID

SELECT p.TGT_ID AS personId, e.TO_STAGE AS stageId, DATE(e.APPLY_DTTM) AS `date`, e.FROM_STAGE AS fromStage, e.BASELINE_IND AS baseline, e.REASON AS reason, CASE WHEN e.ORG_MSTR_CODE IS NOT NULL AND e.ORG_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN e.ORG_MSTR_CODE ELSE p.ORG_MSTR_CODE END AS regionCode, CASE WHEN e.ORG_MSTR_CODE IS NOT NULL AND e.ORG_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN e.ORG_CODE ELSE p.ORG_CODE END AS districtCode, COALESCE(e.BAN_CODE, p.BAN_CODE) AS className FROM TGMSTR p JOIN TGSTGLOG e ON e.LIB_ID = p.LIB_ID AND e.TGT_ID = p.TGT_ID WHERE p.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} AND p.DEL_IND = 'N' AND e.TO_STAGE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.TGT_ID, e.SEQ_NO, e.STG_LOG_ID
SELECT m.SOC_ID AS id, m.SOC_NAME AS name, m.USE_IND AS useInd, m.ALIASES_JSON AS aliasesJson FROM SOCMSTR m WHERE m.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} ORDER BY m.SOC_NAME, m.SOC_ID
mapper.sql: SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_IP, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_IP, SYS_MUSR_DTTM
s.SYS_MUSR_ID = #{stamp.userId}, s.SYS_MUSR_IP = #{stamp.ip}, s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM = GREATEST(#{stamp.utcNow}, DATE_ADD(s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM, INTERVAL 1 SECOND))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PSMSTR (EMPL_ID, EMPL_CODE, EMPL_NAME_HAN, ORG_MSTR_CODE, ORG_CODE, BAN_CODE, TITLE_CODE, JOB_CODE, STATUS_CODE, USE_IND, ) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{newRegion}, #{newDistrict}, #{className}, #{title}, #{job}, #{status}, #{useInd}, )
mapper.update: UPDATE PSMSTR s SET s.EMPL_CODE = #{code}, s.EMPL_NAME_HAN = #{name}, s.ORG_MSTR_CODE = #{newRegion}, s.ORG_CODE = #{newDistrict}, s.BAN_CODE = #{className}, s.TITLE_CODE = #{title}, s.JOB_CODE = #{job}, s.STATUS_CODE = #{status}, s.USE_IND = #{useInd}, WHERE s.EMPL_ID = #{id} AND s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{version}
UPDATE PSMSTR s SET s.USE_IND = 'N', WHERE s.EMPL_ID = #{id} AND s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GOALMSTR (LIB_ID, ORG_MSTR_CODE, ORG_CODE, BAN_CODE, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, STAGE_CODE, PERIOD_CODE, TARGET_CNT, ) VALUES (#{libraryId}, #{newRegion}, #{newDistrict}, #{className}, #{from}, #{to}, #{stageId}, #{periodUnit}, #{target}, )
mapper.update: UPDATE GOALMSTR s SET s.ORG_MSTR_CODE = #{newRegion}, s.ORG_CODE = #{newDistrict}, s.BAN_CODE = #{className}, s.FROM_DATE = #{from}, s.TO_DATE = #{to}, s.STAGE_CODE = #{stageId}, s.PERIOD_CODE = #{periodUnit}, s.TARGET_CNT = #{target}, WHERE s.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} AND s.GOAL_ID = #{id} AND s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE s FROM GOALMSTR s WHERE s.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} AND s.GOAL_ID = #{id} AND s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORGACT (LIB_ID, EMPL_ID, EMPL_CODE, EMPL_NAME, ACT_MONTH, ACT_DATE, PERIOD_KEY, ACT_STATUS_CODE, ORG_MSTR_CODE, ORG_CODE, ) VALUES (#{libraryId}, #{memberId}, #{memberCode}, #{memberName}, #{month}, #{date}, #{period}, #{status}, #{newRegion}, #{newDistrict}, )
mapper.update: UPDATE ORGACT s SET s.ACT_STATUS_CODE = #{status}, WHERE s.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} AND s.ORG_ACT_ID = #{id} AND s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE s FROM ORGACT s WHERE s.LIB_ID = #{libraryId} AND s.ORG_ACT_ID = #{id} AND s.SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{version}
